note: State measured: commit bae29e7de of the branch lot/US-2300/L3, on the base of epic/EP-26 at eeee85e82. US-2250/L3 (#3665, c9b57c00e: the counter of the structure advanced when an element of the breakdown is removed, and the pages of the front rendered as a stream) was merged into epic/EP-26 after the measure and is not in it. First report of a version, taken on 2026-11-16 with `make measure-version MEASURE_VERSION=0.4.0` on a workstation: PRJ-001 of the loaded witness (1000 tasks, 4999 lines of estimate), under fifty virtual users (k6), five passes and three passes of the heavy paths. No previous report, so only the objectives are held; the figures of reference.json, taken before the corrections of EP-26, are quoted as such, not as a previous version. The load: 652 gestures of the 718 expected (91 %), in 144 s — the 66 missing are the time of the gestures themselves and of the end of the load, which the count (one gesture every ten seconds a user, over the duration up to the end of the marking, before k6 is stopped) does not take off; the check asks at least half; reads_refused 0, writes_refused 0, unauthorised 0, conditions.load.refusals empty (a lone refusal, max(floor(1 % of n), 1), would be tolerated and named there); 7 reads and 7 writes refused by the marking (409 STATE_FORBIDS_OPERATION), counted apart as reads_frozen and writes_frozen. Gaps already decided, outside the table: createRevision on PRJ-001 is 2.35 s for the 2 s asked (decision of 2026-11-15, #3314 option B, US-2240), not an operation of table 15; the duration that redates 957 tasks, about 0.8 s, gain under the dispersion (decisions of 2026-11-16, US-2250), is read in recompute-after-entry. Not served, with their epic: the indicators and the projection of expenses (EP-10), the portfolio (EP-11), the compared grid and the entry in a compared grid (EP-27). The three hundred projects and fifteen years of revisions of the reference set (WF-QUA-0040) are for EP-13, which replays this measure on it. The volume of the guarded reads (US-2270) is NOT measured by this report: it is a calculation validated by the author, not a measure. 76 bytes per node x 5994 nodes (PRJ-001) x 600 projects x 180 revisions = about 49 GB, that is 25 to 33 % of the 150 to 200 GB of 4.6.2 (the 82 GB put forward earlier is not retained). Hypotheses: 5994 nodes per revision, that of PRJ-001, for every project; 180 revisions guarded per project, every marked revision read at least once (a revision never read is not guarded); 76 bytes per node as stored, without the compression of PostgreSQL, which would lower it. The compared grid and the entry in a compared grid (EP-27, US-2390) are measured since 2026-11-18: open-compared-grid and recompute-compared alone were carried into this report, from `make measure-version MEASURE_VERSION=0.4.0` on commit d72558abc of the branch lot/US-2390 (with its correction of the step planning.compared-duration, which finds the task by its label in the union), on the base of epic/EP-27 at c9025f66d; the other operations and the conditions above remain those of 2026-11-16, decided on that state. That measure played fourteen steps instead of nine, so its load lasted longer (1277 gestures of the 1395 expected, in 279 s, no refusal, 5 reads and 6 writes frozen by the marking), and the operations already reported moved under it: open-grid 1.116 s (over its 1 s), recompute-after-entry 2.307 s, filter-sort-search 1.161 s, workload-or-projection 0.891 s, mark-revision 0.112 s, import-costs 3.681 s, export-planning 0.414 s; they are given here, not carried. Verdict on option 3 of #3168 (the difference kept at the writing, a fingerprint per node; decision of the author of 2026-11-15: set aside if the two seconds hold, an issue to decide otherwise): the two seconds do not hold, so option 3 is not set aside and becomes an issue to decide. Its figures (make measure-core ONLY=current RUNS=5, PRJ-001 of the freshly loaded witness, the current revision against the marked one it copies): the whole comparison from the rows 0.884 s at the median (spread 52 ms), of which the two readings 0.495 s (56 %), the union 0.290 s (33 %) and the body 0.099 s (11 %); union and body are 44 %, over the 15 % of #3168, so keeping the readings (option 1) does not take most of the gain; from what is kept (after option 1) 0.534 s, union and body 34 %; the tasks alone (kinds=task) 0.807 s, union and body 38 %. The union was never clamped at nought (union_clamped false, runs_union_negative 0 in the three), so the threshold is read on figures not clamped (#3906, point 1, does not play here); the order of readings and comparison alternates over five runs, three one way and two the other (#3906, point 2). Nodes differing: 43 of 5999 (0.7 %; 41 of the 1000 tasks, 2 of the 4999 lines; none by their dates alone), far under the half over which following the differences gains little. What option 3 can take is bounded all the same: the core comparison is 0.5 to 0.9 s of steps of 1.4 to 2.3 s at one user and 2.847 s under load, and recompute-compared carries the redating write too; option 3 alone would not bring recompute-compared under 2 s. The count is that of the witness as loaded, not after a cascade, and no real case was measured.
